pages.title: Where it breaks
pages.lead: What fails, and what we would fix.

points.title: It only ties a simple rule on lateness
points.detail: Earliest finish also reaches 1.7%. Our gain is the checks, reasons and recovery

points.title: Speed costs quality and spread
points.detail: 7.2% of pieces defective against 2.9% at best. One workshop gets 26% of the work, or 20% on a hybrid at 5.1% late

points.title: Some messages go wrong, safely
points.detail: "Is ORD-069 delivered?" got a question, not a refusal. A request to split was read as one order

points.title: Chinese prices
points.detail: A whole-number price was dropped, so the desk asks again. The check needs a fix

points.title: Not tested with real people
points.detail: Workshops are role-played, speech used synthetic voices, and the simulator has no Completed rule

points.title: One Mac runs the desk
points.detail: If it sleeps, the app shows the last update. A hosted desk is the fix
